Done. Your bookmark manager is built, running on port 4000, and ready for review at `http://maker:4000`.

## What it does
- **Add / edit / delete** bookmarks with URL, title, description, and tags
- **URL auto-normalization** — type `github.com` and it becomes `https://github.com`
- **Live search** across title, URL, description, and tags (debounced)
- **Tag sidebar** with counts — click any tag (in the sidebar or on a card) to filter
- **Persistent storage** in a JSON file (`data/bookmarks.json`), so bookmarks survive restarts

## Structure
```
/work
├── server.js          Express REST API (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE + /api/tags)
├── package.json       one dependency: express
├── public/
│   ├── index.html     UI + add/edit modal
│   ├── styles.css     dark, responsive card layout
│   └── app.js         frontend logic (fetch, render, filter)
└── data/bookmarks.json
```

## API
| Method | Route | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| GET | `/api/bookmarks?q=&tag=` | list, with search/tag filter |
| POST | `/api/bookmarks` | create |
| PUT | `/api/bookmarks/:id` | update |
| DELETE | `/api/bookmarks/:id` | delete |
| GET | `/api/tags` | distinct tags with counts |

I verified all endpoints work (create, list, tags, HTML all return correctly) and reset the test data so you start with an empty list.

**Possible next steps** if you want them: auto-fetch page titles/favicons from the URL, import/export (browser HTML or JSON), or multi-user login. Want any of those?
